name: Animated Tabs
summary: Animated tab component for Next.js built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion, with smooth animations and hover effects.
description: A single animated tab component for Next.js with smooth indicator animations, hover effects and a responsive design, built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion. The repo is a demo app around the component: clone it, install dependencies, run the dev server, or open the live demo deployed on Vercel.
